evidence.reason: The fixture initializes a temporary repository and configures only user.email and user.name, then commits at line 94 without disabling inherited commit.gpgSign. If the developer or CI global config enables signing, this commit is attempted under fixture@example.invalid and can fail for lack of a matching key, causing every DeployTests setUp() to error. Adding repository-local commit.gpgSign=false before the first commit is a routine test-isolation fix and also covers later fixture commits.
